items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: And when I went back to Chicago, Jimmy Noon hired me.

ctx.x: He's still here. He's a historian. Yeah, he lives here. He was playing saxophone there. So after he joined the band, and Oliver was taking his job to San Francisco, that's when we went to San Francisco and work up there. So after we started working there a while, I don't know, maybe the people didn't go for Dixland, so they would go to the dance hall like they did. So Oliver wanted to lay off one man. So we think he should lay off Jones instead of Jimmy Pala. So that's when the mix-up come up. So I told him, I…
At that time they called it the Ness.
